checks.name: clifford_products_span_M16

checks.name: pin_commutant_dimension_1

Pin(4,4) is generated by the unit vectors gamma(v), eta(v,v) = +-1, whose span contains every gamma^a; hence the 16-dimensional representation of Pin(4,4) is irreducible (Schur)

checks.name: even_products_span_M8_plus_M8

Hence each half is irreducible and the two halves are inequivalent (if equivalent, the image would have dimension 64)

checks.name: spin_commutant_dimension_2

checks.name: spin_halves_irreducible

checks.name: spin_halves_inequivalent

checks.name: reflections_exchange_halves
checks.detail: gamma^a P_- = P_+ gamma^a for every a: each reflection (an element of Pin(4,4) of determinant -1 in O(4,4)) maps one chiral half onto the other; so the irreducible 16 of Pin(4,4) restricts to Spin(4,4) as the direct sum 8_- + 8_+ of two inequivalent irreducible 8-dimensional representations
